an9.31:1.3: paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa kāmasaññā niruddhā hoti.
an9.31:1.4: dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa vitakkavicārā niruddhā honti.
an9.31:1.5: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa pīti niruddhā hoti.
an9.31:1.6: catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpannassa assāsapassāsā niruddhā honti.
an9.31:1.8: viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samāpannassa ākāsānañcāyatana saññā niruddhā hoti,
an9.31:1.11: saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa saññā ca vedanā ca niruddhā honti.
